findings.highlight: moonlit bridge
findings.evidenceJa: 夜の橋
findings.governingReading: the bridge at night
findings.explanation: Moonlit adds a visible moon and repeats an image that belongs later to Shirou’s memory of the shed.

findings.highlight: If you want to keep Saber
findings.evidenceJa: それでも存命させたいのなら
findings.governingReading: If he nevertheless wants to keep Saber alive
findings.explanation: The English again omits alive from Kotomine’s soul-feeding proposal, weakening its life-and-death stakes.

findings.highlight: Even if I accepted that
findings.evidenceJa: もし俺が望んでも
findings.governingReading: Even if Shirou himself wanted that outcome
findings.explanation: Accepted changes Shirou’s hypothetical desire into assent to Kotomine’s proposal, blurring his admission that part of him was tempted to want it.

findings.highlight: repeat this kind of war?
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争を繰り返す
findings.governingReading: once again repeat this—the Holy Grail War
findings.explanation: This kind of war removes the named cycle Saber would return to and makes the referent generic.

findings.highlight: shut  up…!”  up, you shitty priest…!”
findings.evidenceJa: この、黙りやがれ
findings.governingReading: Damn you—shut up.
findings.explanation: The active English contains two colliding revisions and adds “you shitty priest,” which is absent from Shirou’s spoken line.

findings.highlight: punch at the rails as if shaking off the Command Spell
findings.evidenceJa: 呪縛を振り払うように手すりを殴りつけた
findings.governingReading: He slams the railing as though shaking off an enchantment or binding.
findings.explanation: Command Spell converts the metaphorical hold of Kotomine’s words into the named magical mark, inventing a specific mechanism.

findings.highlight: A hard steel sound echoes through the night.
findings.evidenceJa: きいーん、という音が夜に響く
findings.governingReading: A high metallic ringing resounds through the night.
findings.explanation: Hard steel replaces the audible ringing quality with an unsupported material judgment.

findings.highlight: his words had a charm that make me unable to ignore them
findings.evidenceJa: 否定できない魔力があった
findings.governingReading: His words possessed a magical force Shirou could not deny.
findings.explanation: Charm and ignore soften the coercive intellectual force, while the English clause is also grammatically malformed.

findings.highlight: when I decided to cooperate with Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと手を重ねた時
findings.governingReading: when Shirou joined his hand with Saber’s
findings.explanation: The English replaces a concrete moment of physical and relational union with a generic decision to cooperate.

findings.highlight: I made a sword for her, after that night in the ruins
findings.evidenceJa: 心を重ねた後、彼女の為に剣を作り上げた時
findings.governingReading: after their hearts had joined that night in the ruins, when he completed a sword for her
findings.explanation: The English removes the intimate joining of hearts and leaves only chronology before the projected sword.

findings.highlight: decided I didn’t want to lose her
findings.evidenceJa: 失いたくないと願ってしまった
findings.governingReading: found himself wishing that he did not want to lose her
findings.explanation: The English turns an emotionally involuntary wish into a controlled decision.

findings.highlight: I just don’t like that
findings.evidenceJa: それがたまらなくイヤだった
findings.governingReading: That was unbearably hateful to him.
findings.explanation: Just don’t like sharply reduces the intensity of Shirou’s pain at Saber never having time of her own.

findings.highlight: An unnoticed tear
findings.evidenceJa: 正体の掴めない涙
findings.governingReading: a tear whose nature or cause he cannot grasp
findings.explanation: Unnoticed changes Shirou’s inability to understand the tear into failure to perceive it falling.

findings.highlight: She takes my arm without asking me and starts to walk
findings.evidenceJa: むんず、と問答無用で人の腕を引っ張って、遠坂はずんずんと歩き出して
findings.governingReading: Rin grabs his arm firmly, permits no argument, and strides off with purpose.
findings.explanation: The English retains lack of permission but removes the force and comic determination of Rin’s movements.

findings.highlight: It’s about an hour to the neighboring town.
findings.evidenceJa: 隣町からここまで一時間強
findings.governingReading: The slow walk here from the neighboring town took a little over an hour.
findings.explanation: About an hour removes the explicit excess over one hour and recasts the completed trip as a general travel estimate.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka’s thoughtfulness
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の屈折した心遣い
findings.governingReading: Rin’s roundabout, characteristically indirect consideration
findings.explanation: The English removes the twisted or indirect form of Rin’s care that Shirou specifically appreciates.

findings.highlight: knights that got chased out of Camelot
findings.evidenceJa: 運が悪くて王都を追われた騎士
findings.governingReading: knights who, through ill fortune, were driven from the royal capital, Camelot
findings.explanation: The English omits Rin’s framing of the exiled knights as unlucky rather than necessarily culpable.

findings.highlight: because of Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに対してだった
findings.governingReading: from Saber specifically
findings.explanation: Because of Saber makes the motive causal; Rin is distinguishing the person from whom Archer concealed his identity.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka’s actively talking to me.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂はいつになく積極的に話しかけてくる
findings.governingReading: Rin speaks to him with unusual initiative, revealing an innately big-sisterly impulse to help vulnerable people.
findings.explanation: The English loses both the unusualness of her effort and, later on the page, omits Shirou’s 姉御肌 characterization entirely.

findings.highlight: we drink tea together for a while
findings.evidenceJa: 二人でお茶を飲むこと数十分
findings.governingReading: the two drink tea together for several tens of minutes
findings.explanation: For a while erases the measured, extended duration before Rin finally asks directly.

findings.highlight: her attitude completely changed
findings.evidenceJa: さっきまでの態度とは一変した穏やかさで
findings.governingReading: with a gentleness wholly unlike her attitude moments before
findings.explanation: The English reports change but omits the gentleness that governs Rin’s sincere “I like you two.”

findings.highlight: the mansion is quiet like nothing has happened
findings.evidenceJa: 屋敷は何事もなかったように平穏だった
findings.governingReading: the house is peaceful as though nothing had happened
findings.explanation: Quiet narrows an undisturbed state of peace and safety to absence of sound.

findings.highlight: I step out of character and wish for it to be sunny tomorrow.
findings.evidenceJa: 明日は晴れますように、なんて、ガラにもない事を口にした
findings.governingReading: Out of character, Shirou says aloud a small wish that tomorrow will be clear.
findings.explanation: The English omits that he voices the wish, weakening the final concrete act after his private emotional resolution.
